# Models (generated by `python -m polysafe.models`)

PREREGISTRATION section 8, D2.1a, D7.1, D7.2. Primary cohort: 671 stays, 78 with AKI; 20 stays without a medication record (medication features filled with the training fold's share exposed in the logistic regressions, missing in LightGBM; D7.1). Each stay's 10 out-of-fold predictions are averaged; intervals are patient-level BCa with 10,000 resamples (D2.1a).

## Primary: reduced L2 logistic regression (D4.4)

| Model | AUROC (95% BCa) | AUPRC (95% BCa) | Calibration intercept | Calibration slope |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| Clinical only | 0.641 (0.574-0.707) | 0.216 (0.145-0.302) | 0.001 | 1.052 |
| Clinical + medication | 0.677 (0.611-0.736) | 0.213 (0.149-0.288) | 0.000 | 1.124 |

Resamples used / dropped (D2.1a): clinical only AUROC 10000 / 0, AUPRC 10000 / 0; clinical + medication AUROC 10000 / 0, AUPRC 10000 / 0.

**Paired dAUROC (medication - clinical): +0.036 (95% BCa 0.006 to 0.071)**; resamples attempted / used / dropped 10000 / 10000 / 0.

Realised correlation of the two models' predictions (D2.4, D7.2): 0.928 on the logit scale, 0.926 on the probability scale.

Simulated coverage (D2.1a), cell A0 = 0.7, rho = 0.95, dAUROC = 0.04: dAUROC interval 94.0% (range over the cohort's cells 92.5%-96.5%); clinical-only AUROC 98.5% (98.5%-99.0%); clinical + medication AUROC 98.5% (94.0%-99.5%). AUPRC intervals: coverage not measured.

80%-power threshold in that cell (section 9 null statement, D2.1a): BCa 0.031; section 9.1 percentile 0.030.

## Secondary: LightGBM

| Model | AUROC (95% BCa) | AUPRC (95% BCa) | Calibration intercept | Calibration slope |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| Clinical only | 0.657 (0.589-0.718) | 0.267 (0.181-0.368) | 0.097 | 0.805 |
| Clinical + medication | 0.659 (0.592-0.720) | 0.268 (0.184-0.368) | 0.100 | 0.812 |

Resamples used / dropped (D2.1a): clinical only AUROC 10000 / 0, AUPRC 10000 / 0; clinical + medication AUROC 10000 / 0, AUPRC 10000 / 0.

**Paired dAUROC (medication - clinical): +0.002 (95% BCa -0.009 to 0.015)**; resamples attempted / used / dropped 10000 / 10000 / 0.

Realised correlation of the two models' predictions (D2.4, D7.2): 0.988 on the logit scale, 0.984 on the probability scale.

Simulated coverage (D2.1a), cell A0 = 0.7, rho = 0.95, dAUROC = 0: dAUROC interval 93.5% (range over the cohort's cells 92.5%-96.5%); clinical-only AUROC 98.5% (98.5%-99.0%); clinical + medication AUROC 98.5% (94.0%-99.5%). AUPRC intervals: coverage not measured.

80%-power threshold in that cell (section 9 null statement, D2.1a): BCa 0.031; section 9.1 percentile 0.030.

## Sensitivity: full penalised LR

| Model | AUROC (95% BCa) | AUPRC (95% BCa) | Calibration intercept | Calibration slope |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| Clinical only | 0.624 (0.556-0.686) | 0.182 (0.124-0.248) | 0.005 | 0.954 |
| Clinical + medication | 0.640 (0.574-0.700) | 0.180 (0.127-0.245) | 0.006 | 1.016 |

Resamples used / dropped (D2.1a): clinical only AUROC 10000 / 0, AUPRC 10000 / 0; clinical + medication AUROC 10000 / 0, AUPRC 10000 / 0.

**Paired dAUROC (medication - clinical): +0.016 (95% BCa 0.001 to 0.034)**; resamples attempted / used / dropped 10000 / 10000 / 0.

Realised correlation of the two models' predictions (D2.4, D7.2): 0.982 on the logit scale, 0.977 on the probability scale.

Simulated coverage (D2.1a), cell A0 = 0.7, rho = 0.95, dAUROC = 0.02: dAUROC interval 93.5% (range over the cohort's cells 92.5%-96.5%); clinical-only AUROC 98.5% (98.5%-99.0%); clinical + medication AUROC 98.5% (94.0%-99.5%). AUPRC intervals: coverage not measured.

80%-power threshold in that cell (section 9 null statement, D2.1a): BCa 0.031; section 9.1 percentile 0.030.

Calibration curves, decision curves and the tuning choice of every fit are in `results/model_calibration.csv`, `results/model_decision_curve.csv` and `results/model_tuning.csv`; pooled predictions in `results/model_predictions.csv`.
